method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); three regulative rules (the claim within 3 months with the late claim under LEST, s 6.13(1), (3); the insurer's notice on liability, s 6.19; the claimant's compliance with an insurer's requirement, ss 3.14(2), 3.15(7)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
